- Warnings should include the potential consequences and severity of injuries, both short- and long-term
- Warnings should define and explain terms such as quadriplegia, sickle cell trait, sudden cardiac death, concussion, hypertrophic cardiac myopathy, paraplegia, paralysis, disability, musculoskeletal injury, sprain, strain, arthritis, pathogen, HIVAIDS, and overuse
book: BASICS OF STRENGTH AND CONDITIONING MANUAL
